title: SteakkkClient
description: SteakkkClient is a lightweight client-side mod that enhances Minecraft's visuals and interface with smooth animations and subtle effects. It also provides some quality-to-life features.
body:
![✨ SteakkkClient](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54b533637bbf66d1dab32dc29211f57ac30f643e_0.webp)
**✨ SteakkkClient** is a lightweight client-side Minecraft mod designed to bring **modern visuals, smooth UI, and powerful quality-of-life improvements** to your game while still keeping the **vanilla Minecraft feel**. Instead of cluttering your screen with complicated menus, SteakkkClient provides a **clean, animated interface and fully customizable HUD system** so you can tailor the game exactly to your playstyle.

---

### 🎨 Smooth & Modern Interface

SteakkkClient introduces a **beautiful animated mod menu** with glowing accents, smooth transitions, and a polished layout. Every built-in feature appears as an interactive card where you can **enable, disable, or configure mods instantly**. Searching for mods is fast and intuitive thanks to the built-in search bar.

![Mods Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8f1d713ab817b3cfa7f3397b82c216924537eac.png)
---

### 🧩 Draggable HUD Widgets

Take full control of your HUD.

SteakkkClient allows you to **drag and position important widgets anywhere on your screen**. Smart **snap guides and alignment helpers** make arranging your layout easy and precise.

![Draggable Widgets](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ZRghztmH/images/824d1e44a1e4cfe40cf4468883ac890c8a0bd3e7.gif)
---

Move and organize elements like:

📊 **FPS Counter**

📡 **Ping Display**

🏃 **Sprint Status**

🔍 **Zoom Status**

Create a **clean minimal HUD or a detailed performance layout** — it’s entirely up to you.

---

### 🚀 Built-in Quality-of-Life Features

SteakkkClient includes several useful features designed to improve everyday gameplay:

- 🎬 **Smooth World Join Animation** – cinematic intro when entering a world
- 🔍 **Smooth & Customizable Zoom** – allows you to zoom by pressing any hotkey, and scrolling to zoom-in or out
- 🏃 **Toggle Sprint** – sprint automatically without holding the key
- 🌙 **Fullbright Lighting** – see clearly even in dark caves
- 🏷 **Third-Person Nametags** – view your nametag in third-person with customizable colour and logo.
- 🛡 **Quick Totem Utilities** – lets you swap totem to off-hand and hotbar slots by hovering on totem.
- 📊 **FPS Counter** – monitor your performance in real time
- 📡 **Ping Display** – check your server latency instantly

---

### ⚡ Lightweight & Vanilla-Friendly

SteakkkClient is built to be **fast, lightweight, and unobtrusive**. Every feature is carefully designed to blend naturally with Minecraft so the game still feels **authentic and clean**, just **better**.
